propositions: Mutating CLI verbs (link, unlink, comment, tag, edit, set-file-impact, etc.) currently emit no stdout on success, making silent successes indistinguishable from idempotent no-ops, causing agents to run redundant verification reads and misinterpret failures.

Every verb in _WRITES_FULL and _LIFECYCLE must emit a one-line kubectl-style confirmation (e.g., 'linked <src> -> <target> (<relation>)' or 'no change: already linked ...') on stdout with exit 0, built from CLI args and seam outcome without follow-up store reads.

Global --quiet and --output flags must be extracted at the top-level router before partition dispatch, applying uniformly to all in-scope verbs including positional-only _REGISTRY leaves, with --quiet suppressing text confirmations only and --output json emitting a uniform mutation envelope.

The link REDIRECT record must remain byte-identical on both write and no-op paths including under --quiet, printing as the sole stdout result in text mode with no additional confirmation line added on top.

Already-printing verbs (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition) must normalize to the shared confirmation contract preserving all datum from their original output (e.g., transition preserves UNBLOCKED ids as 'transitioned <alias>: <from> -> <to>; unblocked: <ids|none>').

Consumed seam returns such as add_dependency's dict|None REDIRECT contract must remain unchanged; confirmations are derived from seam outcomes via parallel channels without altering consumed value types or meanings.
